title: Corrupted Kelp
body:
One such tree can cost up to 20,000🍬.

Description

Corrupted Kelp is a tree exlusive to the 2025 Halloween Event. It is found in the Corrupt Biome, along the coastline of Ferwater. Corrupted Kelp has mouth-like appendages that will attack the player if they get too close to it, causing damage as well as pulling the player to the base of the tree.

Obtaining (during Halloween 2025)

Go to the Corrupt Biome during the 2025 Halloween Event and swim along the coastline untill you find the hole in the where you can find the kelp.

Tips during the event:

  • It is recommended to have the Refined Scooba Tank, as it will allow you to more easily reach and harvest the kelp.
  • A Healing Coil or Fusion Coil is also recommended, which allows you to recover faster from the damage taken by the appendages.

Obtaining (outside Halloween event)

  1. Get any kind of kelp (Regular Kelp, Eel Kelp, Arctic Kelp, Luminescentkelp or Plek)
  2. Go to the Uncertainty Cave and let your kelp be hit by the spores of a Mysterious Mushrooms.
  3. Boom! Your kelp will now become corrupted!

Disclaimer! ⚠️

If the tree gets hit only once it will turn into Corrupted Kelp, but if its hit again, it ill turn into regular Corrupted wood. This process is irreversible.
